entities.summary: The Albert Einstein Israelite Hospital is a Brazilian private hospital, located in the Morumbi district, on the south side of São Paulo. It is considered the best hospital in Latin America. In 2024 it was ranked among the top 30 best hospitals in the world by a Newsweek survey of specialists and patients. Although a private hospital the institution is based on a charitable foundation and also attends patients through the Brazilian public health system - SUS.
